mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% over the previous six months signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases by more than 2% over the previous six months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% within two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% within two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3% within a month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP increases by more than 1% and retail and food services sales increase by more than 2% within a month, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and RSAFS increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both GDPC1 and RSAFS meet the trigger conditions.
